description: This source file is a Perl script used for testing and checking translation string options in the cURL project, specifically for OS/400 handling of translatable string options. It parses header and implementation files to verify consistency and ordering of string option definitions.

methods.name: scan_header
methods.description: Scans header files for string option definitions used in cURL.

methods.name: scan_wrapper_for_strings
methods.description: Scans OS/400 specific source files for translatable string options.
